name: .libPaths
title: Library paths kept by this closure

origin.description: This copy does not share base .libPaths. include.site false still appends the R library.

arguments.name: new
arguments.text: Directories to put first. Omit it to return the stored paths.

origin.details: A new path is expanded, kept when it is a directory, and stored with the R library. Calling it does not change the user's library path.
origin.example:
bp_.libPaths <- getFromNamespace(".libPaths", "backports")
dir.create("/tmp/killr-backports-lib", showWarnings = FALSE)
print(bp_.libPaths("/tmp/killr-backports-lib", include.site = FALSE))
